name: Panel
desc: Generic ScapeLite floating panel shell built by UI.panel(): header, body, optional footer, resize corner. Every named panel below is one.
clash: Code comments say "window" and the root has role=dialog, but a Window in our scheme is a big game modal.

name: Header
desc: Top strip: title, optional summary and value, icon buttons. Drag handle of the panel.
clash: The game's own floating panels have a .panel-titlebar; that is the game's header, not this.

name: Title
desc: Panel name, one line.

name: Subtitle
desc: One-line summary under or beside the title. Library only: no plugin uses it yet.

name: Value
desc: The one headline number of a panel, right side of the header. Library only.

name: Chip Text
desc: Short status text shown in the header only while the panel is collapsed (set with setChip).

name: Gear Button
desc: Cogwheel icon button that opens the panel's own settings menu.

name: Collapse Button
desc: Dash/plus button that folds the panel into a Panel Chip and back.

name: Close Button
desc: Cross button that closes the panel.

name: Body
desc: Scrolling content area under the header.

name: Footer
desc: Optional bottom strip. Library only; the queue builds its own (Queue Panel > Footer).

name: Grip
desc: Resize corner in the bottom-right of a panel. Grip always means the resize corner, never a move strip.
clash: Five different classes draw the same corner; "grip" is also used for move strips (#cc-dock-grip, .cc-nd-grip). See Docks and handles.

name: Queue Panel
desc: ScapeLite task queue: current task plus every queued task as Cards, with walking gaps, roll controls and an options Tray.
clash: The game's own queue is #unified-queue-panel = Game Tasks Panel. Never say "the queue" without Queue Panel or Game Tasks Panel.

name: Header
desc: Kit header with a two-line title (name + summary) and gear, collapse, close.

name: Title
desc: "Task queue" title line.

name: Summary
desc: Second header line: total time, XP, task count.

name: Controls Bar
desc: Row under the header with lane switch, slayer masters, credits and Auto chip; can be folded.
clash: Not a Bar in our scheme (Bar = Info Bar, HP bar, menu strip).

path: Queue Panel > Controls Bar > Fold Button
name: Fold Button
desc: Small arrow that folds the Controls Bar to one summary line.

path: Queue Panel > Controls Bar > Fold Summary
name: Fold Summary
desc: One-line text shown while the Controls Bar is folded.

path: Queue Panel > Controls Bar > Lane Switch
name: Lane Switch
desc: Segmented control Skilling | Slay that mirrors the game's own roll lane.

path: Queue Panel > Controls Bar > Master Buttons
name: Master Buttons
desc: Row of slayer master icon buttons (T1..T5), one selected, locked ones dimmed.

name: Credits
desc: Reroll credits readout with how many rerolls it buys; hover for the rules.

path: Queue Panel > Controls Bar > Auto Chip
name: Auto Chip
desc: Chip mirroring the game's Auto Loadout toggle.

name: List
desc: Scrolling stack of Cards separated by Walking Gaps.

name: Footer
desc: Bottom strip with the hint line and the "Nothing queued" note.

name: Hint
desc: Small faint tip text.

name: Route Advisor Panel
desc: Computes the best order and teleport use for the queue and shows three Plan Cards. Display only. Own CSS, not a kit panel.
clash: Looks like a Panel but is not built by UI.panel(): header is .rt-head (not .hd), close is .rt-x, resize is .rt-grip. ui-scale and ui-layout reuse ".rt-head" as its drag handle. The word "route" also names the Map Drawer and the Badge.

name: Header
desc: Draggable top strip: title, Best pill, close.
clash: Shared name: ui-scale.js (HEAD map) and ui-layout.js use .rt-head as the drag handle of this panel only.

name: Title
desc: "Route Advisor".

path: Route Advisor Panel > Header > Best Pill
name: Best Pill
desc: Pill saying "Best: +x% lv/hr" or "Optimal"; turns green when the gain is 2% or more.

path: Route Advisor Panel > Header > Close Button
name: Close Button
desc: Closes the panel (and the Map Drawer).

name: Calc Strip
desc: Strip under the header while it calculates: spinner, text, percent, thin progress bar.

name: Body
desc: Scrolling area under the header.

path: Route Advisor Panel > Body > Change Line
name: Change Line
desc: Dim line saying why the suggestion was updated.

path: Route Advisor Panel > Body > Teleport Mode Row
name: Teleport Mode Row
desc: Row "Teleports: On foot | Efficient | Max" plus the crystal count.

path: Route Advisor Panel > Body > Picks Row
name: Picks Row
desc: Row "Picks: Optimise | Keep mine".

path: Route Advisor Panel > Body > Teleport Upsell
name: Teleport Upsell
desc: Purple callout offering to switch teleports on, with a Use teleports button.
clash: A Callout in our scheme, not a Toast.

path: Route Advisor Panel > Body > What You Could Gain
name: What You Could Gain
desc: Block with a comparison table (keep picks / optimise x foot / teleports); hover cells for the Variant Tooltip.

name: Note
desc: Faint footer text: display-only reminder and search statistics.

path: Route Advisor Panel > Body > Why Box
name: Why Box
desc: Orange-edged box explaining why a plan swapped picks.

name: Tree Advisor Panel
desc: Plans the best Delve and Fortress tree builds; shows steps and saved builds. Display only. Kit panel with a tab strip.

name: Tab Strip
desc: Three big tabs between header and body: Delve, Fortress, My builds.
clash: Tabs here are plain buttons with .on, not .cc-tabs/.cc-tab.

path: Tree Advisor Panel > Tab Strip > Tab
name: Tab
desc: One tab button; .on = selected.

name: Body
desc: Scrolling area: hero, steps, save/share, saved builds, import.

name: Hero
desc: Gradient summary block with the one big number (gain).

path: Tree Advisor Panel > Body > Section Heading
name: Section Heading
desc: Small uppercase heading ("Steps to get there", "Save, share", "Saved builds", "Import a build").
clash: Not .cc-sec; same job, own CSS.

path: Tree Advisor Panel > Body > Step Row
name: Step Row
desc: One node to add or remove; accent edge = add, red edge = remove. Click to highlight on the Tree Map.

path: Tree Advisor Panel > Body > Tree Preview
name: Tree Preview
desc: Canvas picture of the tree inside the panel.

name: Legend
desc: Row of coloured dots naming what the colours on the tree mean.

name: XP Tracker Panel
desc: XP per hour per skill with time frames, graph and per-skill rows. Collapses to a chip showing the total (chipAlways).

name: Icon
desc: Small skill icon at the left of the title.

name: Total
desc: Right-aligned total XP/hr in green.
clash: Plays the role of Panel > Header > Value but is not .cc-hval.

name: Sparkline
desc: 54 px trend line in the header.

path: XP Tracker Panel > Time Frame Chips
name: Time Frame Chips
desc: Row of chips choosing the time window (and Custom).
clash: Two rows share .xp-frames: the time-frame row and the Total / All skills view row.

path: XP Tracker Panel > Custom Frame Editor
name: Custom Frame Editor
desc: Inline "Show the last [n] hours [Set]" row.

name: View Chips
desc: Row of chips: Total | All skills, and XP/hr | XP gained.

name: Graph
desc: Line or stacked-area canvas of XP/hr over the chosen window.

path: XP Tracker Panel > Graph > Hover Tip
name: Hover Tip
desc: Small box following the pointer on the graph.
clash: A hover tip drawn inside the panel; not the shared Tooltip (.cc-tip).

name: Focus Line
desc: One line naming the skill or time under the pointer.

name: Skill List
desc: Container of Skill Rows.

name: Footer
desc: Reset and hint line.

name: Goals Panel
desc: Time-to-goal estimates from your real XP/hr: skill goals, pet chances, item hunts, pins. Kit panel.
aliases: Goal Planner (the game's own strip button is hidden by ScapeLite Menu)
clash: The game has its own "Goal Planner" strip button; ScapeLite Goals is a different thing.

name: Section Heading
desc: Uppercase heading with count: Pinned, Skills you are training, Pets (expected time), Item hunts worth a look, Add a skill goal.

name: Add Form
desc: Select + inputs + button row to pin a new skill goal.

name: Drop Luck Panel
desc: How lucky your drops are: two main tabs (Overview, Detailed); Detailed has five sub-tabs (Pets & Tools, Unlocks, Mobs, Delve, Fortress) that can be dragged into another order. Kit panel.
clash: Id says "droplog", title says "Drop Luck Tracker". The "Fortress Tracker" is only its last sub-tab, not a separate panel.

name: Tab Strip
desc: Underline tab strip between header and body.

path: Drop Luck Panel > Tab Strip > Tab
name: Tab
desc: One main tab (Overview or Detailed).

name: Sub-tab Strip
desc: Second tab row, shown only on Detailed: Pets & Tools, Unlocks, Mobs, Delve, Fortress. Drag a tab to reorder (marker shows where it lands), Shift+Left / Shift+Right moves the focused tab, right-click resets the order.

name: Luck Line
desc: One small line at the top of every sub-tab in the verdict's colour: Luck: Lucky · 83rd percentile · 4 obtained / 2.5 expected. The big Hero stays on the Overview only.

path: Drop Luck Panel > Pets & Tools > Segmented Switch
name: Segmented Switch
desc: Pets, Tools, All: which part of Pets & Tools is shown (remembered).

path: Drop Luck Panel > Overview Tab > Hero
name: Hero
desc: Big luck percentile number with a Luck Meter and sub line.

path: Drop Luck Panel > Overview Tab > Luck Meter
name: Luck Meter
desc: Red-to-green gradient bar with a white marker at your percentile.
clash: A meter, not a .cc-prog Progress Bar.

path: Drop Luck Panel > Overview Tab > Stat Row
name: Stat Row
desc: Row of small centred number boxes.
clash: Own CSS, not .cc-stats.

name: Section Heading
desc: Small uppercase heading inside the body.

name: Search
desc: Search input at the top of a tab.

name: Mob Picker
desc: Dropdown pair choosing a mob, on the Mobs tab.

name: More Button
desc: Centred pill button "Show more".

name: Graph Button
desc: Small kit icon button (chart glyph, aria-pressed = accent) at the end of a drop line. Hover shows the chance-by-kills graph as a hover card; a click pins it inline under the drop.

name: Drop Graph
desc: Inline SVG chart under a drop: chance of having it by kill count, your kills marked, 50/90/99% marks, values on hover.

path: Drop Luck Panel > Unlocks Tab > Category Chips
name: Category Chips
desc: Row of pill buttons on the Unlocks tab: All, Tools, Conduits, Shards, Dungeon extras with counts.

name: Tier Pill
desc: Small pill for one wave band of a special drop (T1 · wave 1); green when you have it. Used in the Chaos Dungeon card and the Fortress loot list.

name: Fortress Tab
desc: The Fortress Tracker: live run card, tier table, run history and log, inside the Drop Luck Panel.
clash: "Gauntlet" is the game's internal name of the Fortress (.gauntlet-hud). Fortress Tracker draws into #cc-droplog.

path: Drop Luck Panel > Fortress Tab > Live Run Card
name: Live Run Card
desc: Box with run title, status Badge, Pills and the tier table.

path: Drop Luck Panel > Fortress Tab > Status Badge
name: Status Badge
desc: Round-edged ok/no badge on the live run card.
clash: Not .cc-badge.

path: Drop Luck Panel > Fortress Tab > Pills
name: Pills
desc: Wrapping row of small boxed facts (waves, rares).
clash: Not .cc-pill.

path: Drop Luck Panel > Fortress Tab > Tier Table
name: Tier Table
desc: 4-column grid: Tier, Expected, Got, Chance of 1+.
clash: A CSS grid, not .cc-table.

path: Drop Luck Panel > Fortress Tab > Run Details
name: Run Details
desc: Collapsible history entry for one past run.

path: Drop Luck Panel > Fortress Tab > Run Log
name: Run Log
desc: List of timed drop lines.

name: Chat Panel
desc: ScapeLite chat with channel chips, search, composer and an in-panel settings sheet. Kit panel.
clash: The game's own chat is the Game Chat Panel (panel id "chat"). Say "Chat Panel" for ours.

name: Channel Strip
desc: Wrapping row of channel chips (Global, Nearby, Raid, Friends, Clan, Game) plus search button.
clash: Called "tabs" in code but they are filter Chips (several can be on).

path: Chat Panel > Channel Strip > Channel Chip
name: Channel Chip
desc: One channel filter. .on = shown, .off = dashed (hidden in game). Unread count in <i>.
clash: Not a Tab: it toggles a filter.

path: Chat Panel > Channel Strip > Search Button
name: Search Button
desc: Magnifier icon button that toggles the Find Bar.

name: Find Bar
desc: Search input under the strip.

name: Message List
desc: Scrolling list of Messages.

name: Jump Button
desc: "New messages" pill at the bottom right of the list.

name: Composer
desc: Bottom row: channel button, text input, character counter.

name: Channel Button
desc: Shows the channel your message goes to; click to change.

name: Settings Sheet
desc: Full-panel overlay with chat options; opened by the gear.
clash: Built with own classes, not .cc-sheet/.cc-set.

path: Chat Panel > Settings Sheet > Sheet Header
name: Sheet Header
desc: Title row with Done button.

path: Chat Panel > Settings Sheet > Setting Row
name: Setting Row
desc: Label plus toggle, slider, select or text field.
clash: Not .cc-set.

name: HP Panel
desc: Small movable panel with ScapeLite's HP bar or number. Header is only a thin handle.
clash: Not the Info Bar's HP module and not the game's .hp-bar. See Disambiguation: three HP things.

name: Handle
desc: The 11 px header strip with a centred grabber; drag it to move.

name: Heart
desc: Heart icon.

name: Bar
desc: Filled HP bar with centred "57 / 80" label.
clash: A progress bar named .bar; not the Info Bar.

name: Number
desc: Big coloured HP number (numbers style).

name: Materials Panel
desc: Appears only when a queued task will run short of materials; one Row per shortage. Kit panel.

name: Shortage Row
desc: Red (short) or orange (needs luck) Row: slot, missing amount, have/need.

name: Bug Report Panel
desc: Form to report a ScapeLite bug: plugin, description, diagnostics, Copy / Open on GitHub. Kit panel.
clash: It is a Panel, not a Modal: it is draggable and does not dim the game.

name: Scope Note
desc: Gold-edged note on what gets fixed.

name: Diagnostics
desc: Monospace box of versions and enabled plugins.

name: Game Window
desc: The game's full-screen modal container that holds Settings, Bank, Crafting and the rest, one tab at a time.
clash: The game says "modal"; we say Window for these and Modal only for ScapeLite dialogs that dim the game (Welcome Tour).

name: Header
desc: Window title bar; ScapeLite uses it as the drag area when a window is floated.

name: Tab Bar
desc: Row of tab buttons to switch between windows.

name: Body
desc: Holds one Window Page per tab.

name: Settings Window
desc: The game's Settings page; ScapeLite adds a Plugins nav button and many sections to it.

name: Header Nav
desc: Row of category buttons (Build, Display ... Plugins) at the top of Settings.

path: Settings Window > Header Nav > Plugins Button
name: Plugins Button
desc: ScapeLite's "Plugins" nav button.

name: Search Box
desc: The game's settings search; ScapeLite sections follow it.

name: Section
desc: One boxed settings group (game's or ScapeLite's).

name: Header
desc: Section title (ScapeLite adds the author tag).

name: Toggle Row
desc: Label, description and a switch; the row type used for most ScapeLite options.
clash: Every ScapeLite row type (select, number, text) reuses the class name "toggle-row".

name: Subheading
desc: Small divider heading inside a section.

name: Bank Window
desc: The game's Bank page; Bank Tools add separators, a size slider, a Settings menu and NEW sparkles.

name: Toolbar
desc: Filter and mode buttons row.

name: Grid
desc: Grid of Bank Slots.

name: Slot
desc: One item cell.
clash: A game cell; not .cc-cell.

name: Smithing Window
desc: The game's Smith page (also Crafting, Imbuing, Brewing windows share the layout). Craft Potential draws on its XP bar.

name: Crafting Window
desc: The game's Craft page.

name: Imbuing Window
desc: The game's Imbue page.

name: Brewing Window
desc: The game's Brew page.

name: XP Bar
desc: The level progress bar at the top of the four crafting-style windows; Craft Potential adds stripes and a label.
clash: A game bar; not an Info Bar and not .cc-prog.

name: Skills Customization Window
desc: The game's lever window for skill weights and quantities; hosts the Lever Advisor Drawer. Also holds the Slay lever page.
clash: Mechanics Explainer and alert-bell call it "Skills / Slay Customization windows"; the code has one tab id.

name: Lever Tooltip
desc: The game's single shared lever tooltip; Mechanics Explainer appends a blue explanation block.

name: Lever Button
desc: The plus/minus buttons that change a weight or quantity.

name: Layouts Window
desc: ScapeLite dialog to save, load and delete named layout presets. Loading reloads the game.
clash: Not the Layout Editor (edit mode of panels, ui-layout.js) and not a kit Panel.

name: Header
desc: Draggable title row with close.

name: Preset Row
desc: One saved preset: name, date, Load and Delete.
clash: Not .cc-row.

name: Add Row
desc: Name input and Save current button.

name: Game Tasks Panel
desc: The game's own task queue panel.
clash: ScapeLite's version is the Queue Panel (#cc-queue). Queue Walk draws bars and tags inside this one.

name: Row
desc: One queue slot of the game's panel.
clash: Not a Row (.cc-row) and not our Card.

path: Game Tasks Panel > Walking Toggle Button
name: Walking Toggle Button
desc: Small button ScapeLite adds to this panel's header to switch walking bars on and off.

name: Game Current Task Panel

path: Game Current Task Panel > Collapse Button
name: Collapse Button

name: Game Skills Panel

name: Game Inventory Panel
desc: The game's inventory panel (panel id inventory).

name: Game Equipment Panel
desc: The game's equipment panel (panel id equipment).

name: Game Chat Panel
desc: The game's own chat panel (panel id chat).
clash: ScapeLite's is the Chat Panel (#cc-chat).

name: Game Floating Panel
desc: Any of the game's draggable panels: tasks, slay, skills, quests, inventory, diary, equipment, friends, barter, chat, taskhud, population (Info), raiddps, gauntlet (Fortress).
clash: The game's word is "panel"; we prefix Game to tell it from ScapeLite's Panel.

name: Titlebar
desc: The game's panel header with its button group.
clash: The game's header; ScapeLite panels use .hd.

name: Game Raid DPS Panel
desc: The game's raid damage panel (panel id raiddps) with tabs DPS Current / DPS Total / Recap; Raid DPS Extras add a Party line and a Graph tab.

name: Tab

name: Button

name: Game Panel Tab Bar

name: Game HP Bar
desc: The game's own hit point bar under the Panel Tab Bar.

name: Game Window Controls

name: Game Dashboard Toast

desc: Pinned Card for Quests.

name: Friends Pinned Card
desc: Pinned Card for Friends.

name: Stops List

name: Route Current Queue Card

name: Goal Skill Row

name: Goal Pet Row

name: XP Skill Row

desc: Tiny boxed tier label like L40 or T5.

name: Tile
desc: Square game picture with tier and markers; kinds skill / kill / empty.
clash: A Tile is one square thing with an icon; a Cell is a grid slot that also shows level and progress.

name: Icon
desc: 30 px (16 px small) pixelated game icon or an emoji in a span.

name: Row
desc: Fixed 44 px list line: lane colour, optional lead, title, sub, meta, optional bar. Never grows.
clash: Our Card is the heavier outlined item (queue); the kit calls the plain one Row.

name: Lead
desc: Left slot: tile or number.

name: Title
desc: First text line.

name: Subtitle
desc: Second, dim text line.

name: Meta
desc: Right column: time and value.

name: Bar
desc: Optional thin progress bar under the text.

name: Action Button
desc: Pin/unpin star or cross at the end of a Row.

name: List
desc: Vertical stack of Rows with gap 6.
aliases: cc-list (library: no plugin uses it yet)

name: Grid
desc: Fixed-column grid of Cells.

name: Cell
desc: Grid slot with icon, level, quantity or bar.
aliases: bank-slot (game) (library: no plugin uses it yet)
clash: Different from Tile; see Tile.

name: Progress Bar
desc: Ratio bar with a tone; --p sets the fill; an inner u shows queued XP.
clash: A bar here is always a Progress Bar; the Info Bar is not a progress bar.

name: Stat
desc: Big number with a label under it; hero variant is larger.
aliases: stats (Drop Luck own) (library: no plugin uses it yet)

name: Stat Row
desc: Row of 2 to 4 Stats.
aliases: cc-stats (library: no plugin uses it yet)

name: Key-Value List
desc: Label / value pairs, values right-aligned.
aliases: dl (library: no plugin uses it yet)

name: Table
desc: Comparison table with numeric columns and signed deltas.
aliases: whyb table (library: no plugin uses it yet)

name: Section Heading
desc: Uppercase heading inside a body, optional count.

name: Graph Frame
desc: Framed box that holds an SVG chart.
aliases: cc-graph (library: no plugin uses it yet)

name: Sparkline
desc: Tiny trend line.

name: Toggle Switch
desc: On/off switch.
aliases: settings-switch (game's, used on the Plugins page)

name: Slider
desc: Range input with a fill (--fill).

name: Input
desc: Single-line text field; aria-invalid = red.

name: Number Input
desc: 72 px right-aligned number field.
clash: Also cc-num-t (tabular figures) and the queue's .cc-q-num (slot number); different things.

name: Select
desc: Dropdown field.

name: Field
desc: Label above an input with an error line.
aliases: cc-field (library: no plugin uses it yet)

name: Settings Row
desc: Bold label, hint text and a control at the right (or below with data-wide).
aliases: settings-toggle-row (game's, used on the Plugins page) (library: no plugin uses it yet)

name: Settings Sheet
desc: Panel-internal settings page that slides over a Panel body.
aliases: cc-sheet (library: no plugin uses it yet)

name: Empty State
desc: Glyph, title and one line when there is nothing to show.

name: Skeleton
desc: Grey shimmering block at the real height while loading.

name: Spinner
desc: Small rotating ring.

name: Scroll Area
desc: Thin-scrollbar container.

name: Hint
desc: Small faint helper text.

name: Divider
desc: Vertical separator in a bar.
aliases: cc-vsep (library: no plugin uses it yet)

name: Dots
desc: Row of step dots (tour).

name: Drag Ghost
desc: Semi-transparent clone following the pointer while dragging a Row or Card.

name: Message List
desc: Kit design for chat lines: Messages in a list.
aliases: cc-msg (library: no plugin uses it yet)
clash: Chat Panel builds its own (.list > .cm).

name: Composer
desc: Kit design for a chat input row.
aliases: cc-newjump (library: no plugin uses it yet)

name: Channel Colour
desc: Sets --t to the text colour for a chat channel.
aliases: cc-chan (library: no plugin uses it yet)

name: Scrim
desc: Dim full-screen layer behind a Modal.

name: Gutter
desc: The gap between items in a list or grid (--cc-gap, density aware). Not an element.

name: Hover
desc: Pointer is over it: background --cc-bg-hover, border strong, 120 ms.

name: Pressed
desc: Mouse down: one step darker, buttons move 1 px; toggles use aria-pressed.

name: Selected
desc: Chosen item: accent fill and edge. Written .on, [aria-selected] or [aria-pressed] depending on the plugin.
clash: Five spellings: .on, .sel, .is-sel, .active, aria-*.

name: Focus
desc: Keyboard focus: 2 px blue outline.

name: Disabled
desc: Dimmed, no pointer events.

name: Locked
desc: Not available yet: dashed, dim, with the reason in the sub line (rows) or a padlock (panels).
clash: Three meanings: Row locked (not yet available), Master button locked (not unlocked), Panel locked (cannot be moved).

name: Highlighted
desc: Advisor spotlight: gold ring with glow and pulse.

name: Advisor Pick
desc: Dashed gold outline: the Route Advisor's choice. Only the advisor uses a dashed line.

name: Attention
desc: Gold 7 px dot on a button or module.

name: Loading
desc: Skeleton blocks or a spinner plus text.

name: Empty
desc: Nothing to show: Empty State.

name: Error
desc: Red callout or toast; never a coloured panel.

name: Good
desc: Green: done, good, skilling.

name: Warn
desc: Orange: caution, medium.

name: Bad
desc: Red-orange: bad, far.

name: Info
desc: Blue: info, quest.

name: Magic
desc: Purple: boost, teleport.

name: Accent
desc: Gold: advisor, selection, the accent colour.

name: Kill
desc: Combat red (--cc-q-kill).

name: Dim
desc: Muted grey.

name: Small
desc: Compact variant: .sm on Button, Tile; data-h=s on the Info Bar.

name: Large
desc: Larger variant: .lg on Tile; data-h=l (42 px) on the Info Bar.
clash: Info Bar heights are called compact / normal / roomy in settings but data-h s / m / l in CSS.

name: Full
desc: Panel 340 px or wider (bars: screen 1100 px or wider). Everything shown.

name: Compact
desc: Panel 180-339 px (bars 700-1099): sub lines fold into meta.

name: Micro
desc: Panel 90-179 px (bars under 700): icons and numbers only.

name: Hover
desc: Panel shown as a Hover Card: no buttons, no grip.

name: Collapsed Chip
desc: Panel folded into its header (a chip).

name: Docked
desc: Panel flush against an Info Bar: square corners on that side.

name: Fused
desc: Panels joined into one group that moves together.

name: Grouped Hidden
desc: A panel behind another in a tab group is hidden.

name: Faded
desc: Panel fades to 30% until hovered.

name: Sized
desc: Panel the player has resized (stops auto height).

name: Floating Window
desc: Game Window in window form (not fullscreen): movable, resizable; see-through lets the game behind stay clickable.

name: Drawer Open
desc: Drawer unfolded.

name: Current
desc: The running task: taller, lane-coloured frame, number shows ">".

name: Open
desc: Card whose option tray is open.

name: Dragging
desc: Source card while a drag is in progress (dimmed).

name: Dropped
desc: Brief flash after a drop.

name: Rolling
desc: Card waiting for a reroll.

name: Frame Colour
desc: data-e: gold lucky, blue quest step, purple XP-boost drop; grey = normal.

name: Lane
desc: data-k: skill (green outline) or kill (red outline).

name: Material Shortage
desc: data-m: bad red triangle, warn orange, save blue i.

name: Chosen
desc: Solid gold outline and a check: the task now in this slot.

name: Advisor Pick
desc: Dashed gold outline and a star.

name: Fastest XP
desc: Bolt badge on the option with the best XP/hr.

name: Waiting
desc: All other options dimmed after a pick, until the game confirms.

name: Short To Long
desc: Walking Gap / Walking Bar colour: green, yellow, orange, red; purple means the game would teleport.

name: Active
desc: Info Bar Module or Panel Button whose panel is open.

name: Dragging
desc: Panel Button being reordered (dimmed).

name: Clickable
desc: Module with a click action (pointer cursor).

name: Look
desc: Icon only, icon and text, or text only.

name: Style
desc: Plain (flat) or separate pills.

name: Selected
desc: Gold edge: the path shown in the map and steps.

name: Best
desc: Path with the best score (gold edge and Best badge).

name: Unavailable
desc: Dim card saying why a path has no option now.

name: Mode
desc: Where the badge sits: in-card (in the game's Tasks panel), docked (tab on the card) or bardock (tab on the Info Bar's Tasks button).

name: Optimal
desc: Green version: the queue is already best.

name: Dot Colour
desc: Green connected, orange warning, red bad; faster pulse when bad.

name: Has Alerts
desc: Bell rings once and the count shows.

name: Open
desc: List is showing.

name: Bell Hidden
desc: Bell button hidden; list still opens from the Info Bar module.

name: Visible
desc: The link appears while a panel is dragged near another.

name: State
desc: sel selected, fz frozen, lk locked, drag being dragged.

name: State
desc: Own = green edge, shiny = animated gold.

name: Height
desc: Info Bar height: compact 28, normal 34, roomy 42 px.

name: Surface 0
desc: Panel, bar and page background #10101a.

name: Surface 1
desc: Menu, tray, overlay background #161620.

name: Surface 2
desc: Rows, cells, chips #1c1c28.

name: Hover
desc: Hover background #262636.

name: Sunk
desc: Wells: progress track, graph frame, inputs #0a0a12.

name: Hairline
desc: Dividers and normal borders #2e2e42.

name: Border Strong
desc: Edges of overlays #4a4a62.

name: Text
desc: Primary text #dcdce8.

name: Text Dim
desc: Secondary text #8f8fa4.

name: Text Faint
desc: Hints only #7c7c93 (tokens block says #707086, components block overrides).
clash: Defined twice with different values; the later one wins.

name: Accent
desc: Gold #ffd24a: advisor, selection, primary button.

name: Accent Fill
desc: Tinted background for selected things #2a2518.

name: Accent Ink
desc: Text colour on accent #241a00.

name: Good
desc: Green #5fe06d.

name: Warn
desc: Orange #ffb84a.

name: Bad
desc: Red-orange #ff8a5c.

name: Info
desc: Blue #4aa8ff.

name: Magic
desc: Purple #b07cff.

name: Combat
desc: Combat red #ee5a5a (and --cc-q-kill-rgb).
clash: "q-" prefix means queue but it is global.

name: Skilling
desc: Skilling green as rgb triplet 95,224,109.

name: Walk Scale
desc: Walk colours as rgb triplets: w1 green, w2 yellow, w3 orange, w4 red, wt purple (teleport).

name: Scrim
desc: Dim layer behind a Modal.

name: Tone
desc: Set by data-tone on a component: --t (colour), --t-a (14% mix), --t-b (42% mix).

name: Gap
desc: Density-aware gap between items (5 / 8 / 11 px).

name: Panel Padding
desc: Density-aware body padding (9 / 12 / 15 px).

name: Row Padding
desc: Density-aware row padding.

name: Font
desc: System UI font stack.

name: Base
desc: 14 px (13 compact, 15 roomy): row title, body.

name: Small
desc: 12.5 px: controls, menu.

name: Extra Small
desc: 11.5 px: sub lines, hints.

name: 2XS
desc: 10.5 px floor: tier chips, headings.

name: Large
desc: 16 px: panel title.

name: XL
desc: 20 px: stat value.

name: Hero
desc: 26 px: the one big number.

name: Radius
desc: 12 px panels, trays, modals.

name: Radius Small
desc: 8 px rows, cells.

name: Radius Extra Small
desc: 5 px tier chips.

name: Low
desc: Row shadow.

name: Popover
desc: Menu, popover, tooltip, toast shadow.

name: Panel
desc: Panel, tray, modal shadow.

name: Fast
desc: 120 ms hover and press.

name: Normal
desc: 180 ms enter.

name: Easing
desc: Calm ease-out curve.

name: Unit
desc: --u = --s x 1 px; set on a .cc-s root by ccScale() from its width.

name: Info Bar Height
desc: 34 px default (28 / 42).

name: Row Height
desc: Row height 44 px (queue card 50 px, current 70 px).
clash: Read with a fallback; not declared on :root.

name: Cell Height
desc: Grid cell height 54 px.
clash: Read with a fallback; not declared on :root.

name: Tile
desc: Tile size 44 px (queue sets it per card).

name: Pill Height
desc: Pill height 20 px.

name: Progress Height
desc: Progress bar thickness 6 px.

name: Panel
desc: Kit panels start at 1100; ui-scale brings the clicked one to the front within the band 1100-1890.

name: Queue Tray Host
desc: 1895: above every ScapeLite panel so alternatives are never hidden.

name: Game Windows
desc: The game's Settings, Bank, Crafting etc. sit at 2000 in the game's own stacking context; ScapeLite panels under them are clipped away (GUARD list).

name: Menu
desc: Menus and popovers.

name: Toast
desc: Toasts.

name: Tooltip
desc: Tooltips.

name: Modal
desc: Modals and Welcome Tour.

name: Notifications
